bibliographic-data.invention-title: COMPOSANT DE COMMANDE ANALOGIQUE POUR UN DISPOSITIF DE DISTRIBUTION D'AÉROSOL
ANALOG CONTROL COMPONENT FOR AN AEROSOL DELIVERY DEVICE

abstract.p: An aerosol delivery device is provided. The aerosol delivery device comprise: a reservoir configured to retain aerosol precursor composition; an atomizer configured to vaporize the aerosol precursor composition when powered by a constant current; a user input interface through which user input is receivable; a control component, responsive to the user input, to direct the constant current to the atomizer to vaporize the aerosol precursor composition; and an indicator electrically coupled between the user input interface and the control component, and configured to provide a visual indication of the constant current being directed to the atomizer in response to the user input.
